insight.summary: Engine recommendation: DEMO-SRC-SUP-001 (Blechbieger Meier), the only technically PASS supplier for U-Halter 800 (LASER_CUTTING+BENDING, S235JR, 800 mm, qty 20, required 2026-11-14, 37 days available). Overall score is 82 with data completeness 0.8 and medium confidence. Its capacity PASS (400 vs 20 required) is Prototype / Local evidence, not a Fusion Manage record. SUP-005 (98) and SUP-002 (88) score higher but are UNKNOWN because no capacity data exists. Five ranked suppliers FAIL on process, material or dimension. The engine counts 9 FAILs, 2 UNKNOWNs and 1 PASS, so some suppliers (e.g. SUP-009) are not in the ranking shown. Two conflicts for SUP-009 need human review.
insight.rankingRationale: Only technically PASS suppliers are eligible for recommendation. SUP-001 is the sole PASS, so it ranks 1 despite a lower overall score (82) than SUP-005 (98) and SUP-002 (88). Those two are ranked 2 and 3 as UNKNOWN: they pass process, material and dimension but have no capacity data. FAIL suppliers (ranks 4-8) have no overall score (null). Their low prices or short lead times do not matter because a technical FAIL is final.
whyPassed: DEMO-SRC-SUP-001 passes on Fusion Manage records: process LASER_CUTTING+BENDING, material S235JR, max dimension 1200 mm (>=800), status not BLOCKED. Its capacity check (400 vs 20) is Prototype / Local evidence. Scores: commercial 79 (quote 18.70), history 52, delivery 100 (lead time 4 days), quality null, overall 82.
whyFailed: DEMO-SRC-SUP-005 and DEMO-SRC-SUP-002 are UNKNOWN, not failed. Reason: 'capacity: no capability data'. SUP-005 scores 98 (price 14.74 from history, 1 purchase, defectRate 0). SUP-002 scores 88 (quote 16.90). Neither is eligible until capacity is confirmed.
DEMO-SRC-SUP-010 FAIL: process LASER_CUTTING+BENDING not offered (PURCHASED_STANDARD). Material S235JR not offered (8.8 steel). Dimension and capacity data are missing. Its 0.18 quote is irrelevant.
DEMO-SRC-SUP-006 FAIL: process LASER_CUTTING+BENDING not offered (POWDER_COATING+DEBURRING). Capacity data is missing.
DEMO-SRC-SUP-007 FAIL: process not offered (TURNING). Material not offered (42CrMo4). Dimension and capacity data are missing.
DEMO-SRC-SUP-008 FAIL: process not offered (MILLING+TURNING). Material not offered (POM). Max dimension is 500 mm against 800 mm needed.
DEMO-SRC-SUP-011 FAIL: material S235JR not offered (1.4301). Capacity data is missing. Its quote is 22.50.
evidenceUsed: Item requirements and supplier capability records come from Fusion Manage. The SUP-001 capacity check is prototype-local.
Prices: quotes for SUP-001/002/006/007/010/011; purchase history for SUP-005 (PO DEMO-SRC-PO-0029, 2026-06-15, 200 pcs at 14.74 EUR, 0 rejected); a similar-item price for SUP-008.
Lead times (1-7 days) come from capability records. All are within the 37 available days.
Similarity evidence: 6 history-family items with score 0.8, from SUP-011, SUP-008 and SUP-005.
Conflicts for SUP-009: (1) its capability record fails process, yet 1 past purchase of U-HALTER-800 exists; (2) quoted 88 vs last purchased 16.11 (2024-10-15).
missingInformation: Quality history is missing for SUP-001, 002, 010, 008 and 011. Both history and quality history are missing for SUP-006, 007, 003 and 012.
Capacity capability data is missing for all ranked suppliers except SUP-001, whose value is only local prototype evidence.
SUP-004 has no price, no history and no quality history.
Every ranked supplier has null on-time rate, null country, null status and null capabilityUpdatedAt. Promised and delivered dates are null on the SUP-005 purchase.
Delivery risk and quality trend are null for all ranked suppliers.
modelInterpretation: Interpretation: confirming capacity for SUP-005 and SUP-002 in Fusion Manage could change which suppliers are eligible. The current recommendation rests partly on prototype-local capacity evidence.
Interpretation: SUP-005's quality score of 100 rests on a single purchase with no delivery dates, so it is thin evidence.

Interpretation: the similarity evidence has historicalDate 2026-12-15, which is after the analysis date of 2026-10-07. The SUP-005 similarity entries also show quantity 500 on 2026-06-15, while the PO shows 200. These look like data-quality issues worth checking.
